text: Let o and d’ then be the motions of the particles in two confine infinite. They would be in equilibrio if urged only by the forces d’r. Therefore if y be the point where the particles which define the one: FM begins to change their velocity, the profiles in D would be equal to the profile when the fluid contained in the canal y EMD would exert, if each particle were folicted by its force d’r. The question is therefore reduced to the finding the curvature in the canal y EMD, and the accelerating force d’r in its different parts.
